name: Match-3 Duel
hook: Match gems, chain combos, bury rivals in stone.
how: Swap gems to line up 3 or more while your stack rises from below. Chains and big matches drop stones on a rival; a board that fills to the top is out. Last board standing wins.
controls: Drag a gem onto a neighbor (or click two), arrows + Space work too; on touch, drag a gem
uses: Every rival's board plays out next to yours, gem by gem.
The host's browser runs the match: who is out, the winner and the restart. If it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots fill empty seats: they look for chains and send stones like a decent player.
Each player's best score in one match.
ideas: Add a bomb gem that clears its whole row
Make it a 2-minute high-score race instead
Turn the gems into candy with a candy-shop look
